The TSLPRB Police Constable selection process includes written examinations
physical tests and certificate verification. Candidates must qualify at the applicable stages of the recruitment process.

Preliminary Written Test (PWT) Physical Measurement Test (PMT) Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Final Written Examination (FWE) Certificate Verification Final Selection as per the applicable post-wise merit criteria
All eligible registered candidates have to appear for the Preliminary Written Test (PWT).
The minimum qualifying marks in the Preliminary Written Test are 30% for OC including EWS
25% for BC and 20% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Home Guard candidates.
The PWT also carries negative marking. In cases other than a single correct response or an unanswered question
20% of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as prescribed in the notification.
Candidates qualifying in the Preliminary Written Test will proceed to the applicable Physical Measurement Test (PMT) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET).
Candidates should carefully check the post-wise and gender-wise physical standards and PET requirements prescribed in the official notification before applying.
Candidates who qualify in the Physical Efficiency Test will be required to appear for the Final Written Examination (FWE). The examination consists of one paper of three hours duration.
The minimum qualifying marks in the Final Written Examination are 40% for OC including EWS
35% for BC and 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 7,112 vacancies have been notified under TSLPRB Recruitment 2026. The vacancies are distributed among the Telangana Police Department, Telangana Special Protection Force Department, Telangana Fire, Disaster Response, Emergency and Civil Defence Department, and Telangana Prisons & Correctional Services Department. The number of vacancies is tentative and may change during the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the educational qualification, age, gender, physical and other eligibility requirements applicable to their selected post. Candidates must have passed Intermediate or an equivalent examination recognized by the State Government as on 29 July 2026 . Candidates possessing qualifications higher than the prescribed Intermediate qualification will also be considered on par with candidates possessing the required qualification. For Post Code 26 - Fire Fighter , candidates must additionally possess a valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) driving licence as on the date of notification.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: For Post Codes 21 to 23, 25, 26, 27 and 28 , the prescribed basic age requirement is 18 to below 22 years as on 01 July 2026 . However, the Government of Telangana has provided an additional relaxation of 5 years in the upper age limit for direct recruitment to uniformed services, including Police, Fire Services, Prisons and Special Protection Force Departments. Further category-wise and special-category age relaxations apply as prescribed in the official notification. Candidates should check the age conditions applicable to their category before applying.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notified posts carry a pay scale of Rs. 24,280-72,850 .

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee amount will be determined through the TSLPRB online application system based on the post or posts selected by the candidate. OC and BC candidates with Telangana local status have to pay the fee designated in the online application. Local SC and ST candidates of Telangana will pay the applicable concessional fee. Other candidates must pay the fee designated by the online application system. Candidates applying for multiple eligible posts may receive the applicable fee rebate as prescribed in the notification. The application fee can be paid using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or other payment methods made available on the TSLPRB website . Fee once paid will not be refunded.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Important Dates 2026
content_sections.text: Important: TSLPRB has clearly stated that the exact dates for submission of the Online Application Form will be intimated in due course through a separate press release. Candidates should not treat the notification date as the application start date.

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The TSLPRB Police Constable selection process includes written examinations, physical tests and certificate verification. Candidates must qualify at the applicable stages of the recruitment process. Preliminary Written Test (PWT) Physical Measurement Test (PMT) Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Final Written Examination (FWE) Certificate Verification Final Selection as per the applicable post-wise merit criteria All eligible registered candidates have to appear for the Preliminary Written Test (PWT) . The minimum qualifying marks in the Preliminary Written Test are 30% for OC including EWS, 25% for BC and 20% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Home Guard candidates . The PWT also carries negative marking. In cases other than a single correct response or an unanswered question, 20% of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as prescribed in the notification. Candidates qualifying in the Preliminary Written Test will proceed to the applicable Physical Measurement Test (PMT) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET) . Candidates should carefully check the post-wise and gender-wise physical standards and PET requirements prescribed in the official notification before applying. Candidates who qualify in the Physical Efficiency Test will be required to appear for the Final Written Examination (FWE) . The examination consists of one paper of three hours duration. The minimum qualifying marks in the Final Written Examination are 40% for OC including EWS, 35% for BC and 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates .

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Apply Online Date 2026
content_sections.text: The TSLPRB Police Constable Apply Online 2026 dates have not yet been announced . The recruitment board has stated that the exact dates for submission of the online application form will be communicated through a separate press release. Candidates should regularly check the official TSLPRB website for the application start date, last date and related updates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Applications for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026 will be accepted online only through the official recruitment website. Visit the official TSLPRB website at tgprb.in . Register using your mobile number as the User ID. Select the notification and post or posts for which you are eligible. Check the application fee generated based on the posts selected. Pay the prescribed fee using an available online payment method. Open the Apply Online section and complete the Part-I application. Upload the passport-size photograph and specimen signature as prescribed. Check all entered details carefully before submission. Submit the online application. Download and save the submitted application form for future reference. Candidates qualifying in the Preliminary Written Test will later have to submit the Part-II Online Application and upload the required certificates/documents as per the schedule announced by TSLPRB.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the applicable certificates and documents ready for the recruitment process. These include educational, date of birth, community, local candidature and other category-specific certificates as applicable. SSC/Matriculation Certificate or equivalent proof of Date of Birth Intermediate or Equivalent Certificate Community Certificate, if applicable SC Sub-classification Certificate, if applicable Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for eligible BC candidates EWS Income and Asset Certificate, if applicable Bonafide/Study/Residence Certificates for local candidature Special Category Certificates, if applicable Ex-Servicemen documents, if applicable Other documents prescribed by TSLPRB for the candidate's category

content_sections.heading: TSLPRB Police Constable Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The TSLPRB Police Constable online application link will be available after the Board announces the application schedule. Candidates who have completed their Intermediate and are seeking uniformed services roles can also explore more Telangana Government Jobs and Police Recruitment Jobs across India. Applicants preparing for physical efficiency-based recruitments can also check the latest Police Constable Recruitment 2026 notifications and Defence & Security Jobs for similar opportunities. Those looking for other Telangana state government openings can browse TSPSC Recruitment 2026 and TG Government Jobs matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TSLPRB has notified a total of 7,112 vacancies for Police Constable, SPF Constable, Fire Fighter and Warder posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many TSLPRB Police Constable Civil vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 3,697 SCT Police Constable (Civil) vacancies under Post Code 21.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) or an equivalent examination recognized by the State Government as on 29 July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The basic prescribed age for the notified posts is 18 to below 22 years as on 01 July 2026. The Telangana Government has also provided an additional five-year relaxation in the upper age limit for direct recruitment to uniformed services. Other applicable category-wise relaxations are subject to the notification conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for TSLPRB Police Constable posts?
faq.answer: The notified posts carry a pay scale of Rs. 24,280-72,850.

faq.question: Q6. What is the TSLPRB Police Constable application fee?
faq.answer: The applicable fee will be determined by the TSLPRB online application system based on the post or posts selected and the candidate's applicable category/status.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process includes a Preliminary Written Test, Physical Measurement Test, Physical Efficiency Test, Final Written Examination and Certificate Verification, followed by final selection according to the applicable post-wise merit criteria.

faq.question: Q8. When will TSLPRB Police Constable applications start?
faq.answer: The exact TSLPRB Police Constable Apply Online Date 2026 has not yet been announced. TSLPRB will release the application schedule separately through a press release.

faq.question: Q9. What is the last date to apply for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date has not yet been announced. Candidates should check the official TSLPRB website for the application schedule.

faq.question: Q10. Can women apply for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Women are eligible for Post Codes 21, 22, 25 and 26. Post Code 28, Warder (Female), is specifically for women. Post Codes 23 and 27 are for men only.
